note: Original GetEdge work, distilled from a production pipeline used to edit real vlog shorts and a product launch reel. The cut judge, the editing grammar and every enforced rule come from real renders that were reviewed, called broken, fixed and re-judged. No code was copied from another project. Fonts are not bundled: `vlog.py setup` downloads Inter 4.1 (SIL Open Font License) from its official release. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap at render time and must be attributed on screen.
